thread:
nisha (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on reviews/comp — posting the main clarifications here. please flag anything missing.

nisha (People Ops): TL;DR timeline: kickoff May 10, self-reviews due May 24, calibration Jun 1-7, notifications Jun 21. full guide: https://redwood.example.com/hr/reviews-2026

claire (IC): If I started Apr 20, am I eligible for merit this cycle?

nisha (People Ops): new hires are eligible for merit if they've been in role 60 days by the end of the self-review window. for promotions we usually require 6 months unless it's exceptional (manager+director signoff).

ben (Manager): For off-cycle comp requests, what's the expected approval lead time?

nisha (People Ops): mid-cycle comp requests typically take 2-3 weeks for review depending on approvals. urgent retention cases flagged by Director can be expedited. submit via the CompChange form.

raj (Dir, Eng): managers — please include concrete measures of impact in notes (metrics, customer impact, cross-team leadership). vague descriptors slow calibration.

claire (IC): equity refreshes — when do promoted individuals get grants?

peopleops-bot: equity-refresh-2026: grant run usually late June after notifications; timing subject to board approval.

nisha (People Ops): promoted folks are prioritized for the June grant window but not guaranteed. we'll state specifics in the notification email.

ben (Manager): if we discover a material comp error after notifications, can we correct it?

nisha (People Ops): yes — HR will process corrections. please escalate via the compensation queue with documentation.

peopleops-bot: Quick poll: Would managers like a 30-min calibration walkthrough session?
Yes  7
No  2

nisha (People Ops): thanks everyone. we'll post the calibration template and examples in #people-ops and schedule office hours. DMs welcome for case-by-case help.
